quizName: DMV Practice Test #5 20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: Which surface provides good traction?
questions.explanation: Dry pavement provides good traction. Wet pavement, loose gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, and painted lane markings all have poor traction and are hazardous for motorcycles.

questions.question: Riding clothes should protect you from all of the following except:
questions.explanation: Riding clothes protect you from sunburn, windburn, rain, dehydration, cold, and motorcycle parts. They also protect you in a crash. Chapped lips are not something motorcycle clothing protects against.

questions.question: A person drinks 7 drinks in 3 hours. The body removes 1 drink per hour. How many drinks remain 3 hours after their last drink?
questions.explanation: To find drinks remaining, subtract the hours since the last drink from total drinks consumed. This person drank 7 drinks and 6 hours have passed (3 hours drinking + 3 hours after). The body removes 6 drinks, leaving 4 drinks in the system.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed with caution. Slow down and watch for hazards when you see a flashing yellow light.

questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing while riding?
questions.explanation: Wear reflective and bright clothing anytime you ride. Crashes happen in daylight and at night. Being visible at all times keeps you safer.

questions.question: How do you stop quickly on a motorcycle?

options.text: Throttle down and use the front brake
Use both brakes at the same time

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both brakes at the same time
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, apply both the front and rear brakes at the same time.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, what should you do when turning?

options.text: Turn your head and shoulders to look through the turn
Keep your knees away from the gas tank
Turn only your head and eyes to look through the turn

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn only your head and eyes to look through the turn
questions.explanation: When turning, turn only your head to look where you want to go. Keep your knees against the gas tank for balance. Your arms should be slightly bent when holding the handgrips.

questions.question: How many alcoholic drinks does the body eliminate per hour?
questions.explanation: The body eliminates about one drink per hour on average. This rate varies by person. Do not ride any motor vehicle after drinking alcohol.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what should motorcyclists do?

options.text: Should reduce their usual space cushions by half

questions.explanation: When riding in a group, keep close ranks but maintain an adequate space cushion around each rider.

questions.question: If you wait one hour per drink before riding, what happens?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding
Your riding skills will not be affected
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly

questions.explanation: The body eliminates one drink per hour on average. However, alcohol can still build up in your system. Side effects may remain even if you wait one hour per drink.

questions.question: What color are warning signs for hazardous locations?
questions.explanation: Warning signs about hazards are yellow with black letters or symbols. Always pay attention to these signs.

questions.question: When another vehicle is passing you, where should you ride in your lane?

options.text: Ride in the center portion of the lane.
Ride in the left portion of the lane.
Ride in the right portion of the lane.
Weave among the three portions of the lane as the vehicle passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride in the center portion of the lane.
questions.explanation: Ride in the center of your lane when being passed. Riding on the side closest to the passing vehicle increases collision risk. Riding on the far side may cause the other driver to merge back too soon.

questions.question: How should you load cargo on a motorcycle?

options.text: Pack heavier items in front of the tank bag.
Pack lighter items near the front.
Try to not place items over the rear axle.
Place items behind the rear axle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pack heavier items in front of the tank bag.
questions.explanation: Put heavier items in front of the tank bag. Place the load over or in front of the rear axle. Placing the load behind the rear axle can affect your control.

questions.question: What is a major effect of drinking alcohol?

options.text: The slowing down of bodily functions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The slowing down of bodily functions.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows down your physical and mental functions.

questions.question: In New York State outside New York City, what can you do at a red traffic light?
questions.explanation: In New York State, except in New York City, you can turn right on a red light. You must stop first and yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic. In New York City, you can only turn right on red if a sign permits it.

questions.question: When do most motorcycle crashes happen?

options.text: After at least an hour of riding.
After more than 8 hours of riding.

questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes occur on short trips—less than five miles—within the first few minutes of riding.

questions.question: What color are signs that show where services are located?

options.text: Blue with white letters or symbols.
Green with white letters or symbols.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blue with white letters or symbols.
questions.explanation: Service signs showing rest areas, gas stations, campgrounds, and hospitals are blue with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: What is the best lane position for a motorcycle?

options.text: There is no single best lane position.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is no single best lane position.
questions.explanation: There is no single best lane position. Change your position as road and traffic conditions change. Choose a position that gives you the most space and helps other drivers see you.

questions.question: How should a group of motorcyclists ride through a curve?
questions.explanation: Groups should ride in single-file when taking curves, turning, or entering or leaving a highway. A staggered formation is used on straight roads.

questions.question: Is the oily strip in the center of a lane safe for motorcyclists?

options.text: Usually safe, unless the road is wet.
Usually safe, unless it is sunny outside.
Always safe, no matter the weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Usually safe, unless the road is wet.
questions.explanation: Oil from cars collects in a strip in the center of lanes. When the road is dry, this area provides enough traction for motorcycles. When wet, it becomes slippery. The strip is usually narrow enough that you can ride to one side of it and still be in the center portion of the lane.
